meta.title: SmartMGTS — Sales & Distribution, Digitized
meta.description: SmartMGTS builds SaaS platforms and web apps that digitize sales, distribution and ISO management for FMCG and distribution companies in Bangladesh.

productsSection.title: Our Products
productsSection.subtitle: Every product below solves a real problem for a real client

iso.name: ISO Management System
iso.desc: Helps a company plan, document and track its International Organization for Standardization (ISO) compliance work in one place, instead of scattered paper files and spreadsheets.

dist.name: Sales & Distribution Management
dist.desc: Our core platform: dashboards, geo-based route planning, employee & device control, target setting, and customer collections for distribution businesses. Runs as a separate, dedicated instance for each client company.

taj.name: Tajmahal Takeaway
taj.desc: A custom restaurant website built for Tajmahal Takeaway, where customers can browse the menu and place orders online.

dokaner.name: Dokaner Ponno
dokaner.desc: An app built for retailers and microdealers to manage their business - currently under active development.

fmcgpro.name: FMCG Pro BD
fmcgpro.desc: A platform for the sales & distribution side of the FMCG (fast-moving consumer goods) sector in Bangladesh.

fmcgprofessionals.name: FMCG Professionals
fmcgprofessionals.desc: A membership site for FMCG professionals to join and be counted as part of the FMCG Pro BD community.
fmcgprofessionals.clients: Member registration for FMCG Pro BD

featuresSection.title: Key software features
featuresSection.subtitle: The modules our Sales & Distribution platform is built around — the same modules that run inside Peerless, FDH and MNCorp today.

dashboard.title: Dashboard & Analytics
dashboard.desc: Real-time business insight: SKU analysis, collection analysis, lifting vs. collection reports, and customer ledgers.

geo.title: Geo Setup
geo.desc: Admins configure Regions, HQ, Points and Routes, so territory and route-based sales tracking stays accurate.

auth.title: Authorization & Device Control
auth.desc: Login-device monitoring and device-based access control for accountability and security.

employees.title: Employees Management
employees.desc: Employee profiles, role-based access control, and activity tracking in one place.

targets.title: Target Management
targets.desc: Monthly and weekly targets for SR, DSR and DD, tracked against real performance.

collection.title: Collection Module
collection.desc: Customer-wise collections, outstanding balances, and full collection history.

benefitsSection.title: Built to remove paperwork and win back time

paperless.title: Paperless work
paperless.desc: Field data, approvals and reports move online instead of through paper registers — easier to search, harder to lose.

timesaver.title: Time saver
timesaver.desc: Automated collections, targets and reporting free up hours that used to go into manual data entry.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.desc: Application backends run on AWS; the frontend is served through cPanel, keeping deployment and data handling separated and controlled.

q1.q: Is your software suitable for my type of business?
q1.a: Our Sales & Distribution platform is built for small and medium-sized distribution and sales enterprises that want to digitize field operations, and our ISO Management app is built for companies managing formal ISO compliance.

q2.q: Can I get a customized solution for my business?
q2.a: Yes. Each client runs their own dedicated instance of the platform, and our team can adapt modules to fit specific logistics or reporting requirements.

q3.q: Where is my data hosted, and is it secure?
q3.a: Application backends are hosted on AWS, with the frontend served separately through cPanel — a setup chosen to keep infrastructure secure and manageable.

teamSection.title: A small team, hands-on with every client
teamSection.subtitle: Three people cover consulting, development and support across all six products.

about.title: Software for the people who move goods every day
about.subtitle: SmartMGTS builds the systems that FMCG and distribution companies in Bangladesh use to run sales, collections and compliance — replacing paper registers with dashboards their teams actually use.
about.storyBody: We design and build SaaS platforms and websites for the sales & distribution sector: a dedicated Sales & Distribution Management system for distribution companies, an ISO Management system for formal compliance work, and standalone web apps — from a restaurant ordering site to an FMCG community platform — for clients with more specific needs.
about.approachBody: Every client gets their own dedicated application instance rather than a one-size-fits-all account, so modules like Geo Setup, Target Management and Collections can be adapted to how that business actually runs its routes and territories. Backends are hosted on AWS; frontends are served through cPanel.
about.teamSubtitle: Three people, covering consulting, development and delivery for every product on this site.
